fact_previews: The Mobile FlashCards App for Exam Preparation was created by Jennifer Graham.
The app is designed for certification exams in ITIL, CISSP, PMP, PMO, OCM, and CBAP.
The app is intended for both Android and iPhone platforms.
The funding goal for the project was $70,614.
The project was unsuccessful in reaching its funding goal by March 2, 2016.
